milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The agent must navigate near the composter (within 5 blocks) AND face toward it (within 60° tolerance), confirming they have visually identified the composter block at the farm area. The composter is at spawn-relative [2, 1, 2]. This rule type is preferred over position_inside_box for find tasks because it models 'player can see the target'.
